taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): evergreen shrub-like or small trees up to 12 m; the lower bound is the model estimate's usual height (species-facts-2026-10-15).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 5.5-12 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 1.8-3.2 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole 0.7-1 cm, purple-red when fresh.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 197, Laurus nobilis: leaves lanceolate with a wavy margin (Flora of China: oblong or oblong-lanceolate, margin slightly undulate).

traits.sexual_system.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): dioecious, as Dendrology (p. 367) says too.

traits.inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: axillary umbels of 5-6 flowers (Flora of China: umbels 1-3 together on a short raceme).

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of China vol. 7, Laurus nobilis (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): perianth lobes 4, in two pairs; Dendrology (p. 367) counts 4 too.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: flowers 5-8 mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: flowers yellowish to greenish white. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: fruit a berry.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: fruit 1-1.5 cm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: ripe fruit black and shiny (Flora of China: dark purple). The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flowering_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: flowers March-April.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 367, Laurus nobilis: fruit ripe August-October.

generator.params.note: Pacific madrone's crown values, changed by hand for a shrub-like small tree: several stems from near the ground, steep branches into a dense, narrow crown (Flora of China: evergreen shrub-like or small trees). Not fitted to measurements. spur_leaf is the leaf card the angiosperm rule gives leaf_size, 1.5 times the flora's mean blade, so short-shoot leaves are drawn the same size.

allometry.note: 8 m at 30 years in the open, within Flora of China's 'up to 12 m'. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after Flora of China and Simpson: blackish-brown bark; dark green, leathery, wavy-edged leaves. The leaf card's petiole is 0.09 of its length, the flora's petiole against blade and petiole together.
